pages.quiz:
CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Roles of Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Roles of Creative Arts and Sports.
   B. Practise Roles of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Roles of Creative Arts and Sports.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Roles of Creative Arts and Sports.

2. Best practice when working on Drawing and Painting: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Drawing and Painting.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Drawing and Painting.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Drawing and Painting.
   D. Practise Drawing and Painting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Remove the need for rules
   B. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   C. Guarantee a trophy
   D. Replace drinking water

4. Best practice when working on Swimming: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Swimming.
   B. Damage equipment used for Swimming.
   C. Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Swimming.

5. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Craft: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Craft with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Craft.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Craft.
   D. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Craft.

6. Best practice when working on Fabric Decoration: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Fabric Decoration.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Fabric Decoration.
   C. Practise Fabric Decoration with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Fabric Decoration.

7. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   C. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.

8. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Brown, pink, and gold
   B. Green, orange, and purple
   C. Black, white, and grey
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

9. Best practice when working on Components of Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   B. Damage equipment used for Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   C. Practise Components of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Components of Creative Arts and Sports.

10. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the volume
   B. Only the costume
   C. The ticket price
   D. The speed of the music

11. Best practice when working on Netball: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Netball.
   B. Practise Netball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Netball.
   D. Damage equipment used for Netball.

12. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Games: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Kenyan Indigenous Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Indigenous Games.
   C. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Indigenous Games.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Indigenous Games.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Components of Creative Arts and Sports and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Drawing and Painting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyan Folk Dance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Indigenous Kenyan Craft and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. B — Practise Roles of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

2. D — Practise Drawing and Painting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. B — Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

4. C — Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. A — Practise Indigenous Kenyan Craft with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. C — Practise Fabric Decoration with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. C — Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. D — Red, blue, and yellow

9. C — Practise Components of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. D — The speed of the music

11. B — Practise Netball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

12. A — Practise Kenyan Indigenous Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Components of Creative Arts and Sports; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Drawing and Painting; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Kenyan Folk Dance; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Indigenous Kenyan Craft; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
